title: What non-agentic local AI programs do you run?
body: I have Handy for speech to text and I'll try audio.cpp soon. Also tried an embedder for semantic code search (qwen embed + qdrant + ZooCode). Haven't dabbled with image gen AI at all yet, but very interested in it. submitted by /u/YetAnotherAnonymoose [link] [comments]
